Personality: Kallisto, a prominent figure of the Megalopolitai, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Kallisto owes allegiance to the Achaean League, hailing from the noble house of Megalopolitai. Historical Record: Wife of Lykortas, of the Megalopolitai, a Greek house of the Achaean League. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
